items.statement: Operating profit before tax grew 20.2% year-on-year to INR 1,100 crores during the quarter.
items.quote: Operating profit before tax, which indicates the core profitability of our business, it reached INR1,100 crores. This represents a 20.2% increase on year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Profit after tax increased by 23.1% year-on-year to reach INR 965 crores.
items.quote: Profit after tax stood at INR965 crores which is up by 23.1% on year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Other income turned positive to INR 181 crores due to mark-to-market gains as of June 30th.
items.quote: Other income of INR181 crores turned positive from negative on the back of positive mark-to-market as of June 30th as compared to March 31st.

items.statement: Operating expenses rose 14.3% sequentially and 11.7% year-on-year to INR 464 crores, primarily led by employee costs.
items.quote: Operating expenses amounted to INR464 crores which was an increase by 11.7% year-on-year and 14.3% quarter-on-quarter. The sequential increase was largely on account of employee expenses.

items.statement: Monthly systematic transaction inflows decreased slightly from INR 5,104 crores in March 2026 to INR 4,872 crores in June 2026.
items.quote: In June 2026, our systematic transactions, which includes SIPs and Systematic Transfer Plans, moderated marginally to INR4,872 crores from INR5,104 crores in the month of March 2026.

items.statement: The company is assessing further inbound and outbound product opportunities to launch in GIFT City.
items.quote: We are continuously evaluating more product opportunities, both inbound and outbound and we'll work on that and launch them in due course.

items.statement: Management plans to continue rolling out regular product launches across categories over the next nine months.
items.quote: We will come up with our launches. You'll see regular you must be seeing a lot of launches and you will see regular launches in the next 9 months

items.statement: Monthly SIP inflows remained resilient across the first quarter despite volatile market conditions.
items.quote: Monthly SIP inflow remained largely stable throughout Q1 Financial Year 27, despite volatile market conditions, demonstrating the resilience and stickiness of the retail investor participation.

items.statement: The company maintained industry-leading net inflows during Q1 FY27.
items.quote: It is important to note that in Q1 FY27, we continued to receive one of the highest net flows amongst the industry.

items.statement: Changes in total expense ratio regulations had no adverse financial impact on the company.
items.quote: There is no negative impact on account of changes in the TER regulations.

items.statement: The company recorded an annualized gross yield of 52.4 basis points and a net yield of 48.3 basis points for the quarter.
items.quote: For the quarter ended June 2026, our gross yield and net yield on an annualized basis stood at 52.4 basis points and 48.3 basis points respectively.

items.statement: Employee expenses included the commencement of ESOP charges in Q1, which were not present in the prior year.
items.quote: As we had mentioned in our previous call you would remember, the ESOP related expenses have started debiting from this quarter, while no such charge was there in the P&L in the last year.

items.statement: Annualized margins stood at 66 basis points for equity, 32 basis points for debt, and 12 basis points each for liquid and passive strategies.
items.quote: For the quarter ended June 2026, our margins on an annualized basis stands at 66 basis points for equity, 32 basis points for debt, 12 basis points for liquid, 12 basis points for passives, and 30 basis points for arbitrage.

items.statement: Operating margins improved to 36.9 basis points compared to 36.1 basis points in the prior-year period.
items.quote: For quarter ended June 2026, our operating margins stood at 36.9 basis points as compared to 36.1 basis points for the quarter ended June 25, which is the same quarter last year.

items.statement: The AMC introduced the Active Asset Allocator Fund and Equity Long-Short Fund under its specialized investment fund umbrella in June 2026.
items.quote: iSIF Equity Ex Top 100 and iSIF Hybrid Long-Short Fund was launched in previous quarter, while iSIF Active Asset Allocator Fund and iSIF Equity Long-Short Fund in June 2026.

items.statement: The company rolled out the ICICI Prudential Smart Navigator Fund as its initial inbound fund in GIFT City.
items.quote: Coming to GIFT City, we had launched our first offering in GIFT City, the ICICI Prudential Smart Navigator Fund, which is an inbound fund.

items.statement: The company has deployed artificial intelligence to answer 60% of customer queries received over email.
items.quote: On the operational efficiency front, 60% of our customer queries over email are replied using AI.

items.statement: The mutual fund industry's quarterly average AUM reached INR 83.28 lakh crores, growing 15.4% year-on-year.
items.quote: If I talk about the industry, the industry's quarterly average AUM has grown by 15.4% year-on-year and 2% sequentially in Q1 27, reaching INR 83.28 lakh crores.

items.statement: Debt segment average AUM across the industry fell 6% quarter-on-quarter to INR 11.93 lakh crores amid tight liquidity and institutional redemptions.
items.quote: In the debt segment, quarterly average AUM stood at INR11.93 lakh crores. The quarter witnessed redemptions by institutions, investors amid tight liquidity conditions resulting in a sequential moderation of 6% in quarterly average AUM.

items.statement: PAT rose only 6.1% YoY and fell 7.8% QoQ to Rs 889 crore.
items.quote: Profit after tax stood at 889 crore rupees, which is up by 6.1% year on year, and has a degrowth of 7.8% quarter on quarter

items.statement: Monthly systematic transactions (SIP + STP) fell to Rs 4,672 crore in September from Rs 4,872 crore in June.
items.quote: our systematic transaction, which includes SIPs and systematic transfer plans, moderated to 4,672 crores, from 4,872 crore rupees in June 2026

items.statement: Full-year ESOP cost guidance of Rs 64-68 crore is maintained, charged pro rata.
items.quote: that total ESOP cost, for this financial year, would be between 64 to 68 crores. So accordingly, the charge happens to the P&L on a prorata basis.

items.statement: Alternates net yield is expected in a 90-95 bps range.
items.quote: you should see the yield in the alternate in a range between net yield between 90 to 95 basis points.

items.statement: H1 FY27 annualised operating margin was 37.3 bps versus 36.6 bps a year earlier.
items.quote: For H1 FY 27, our operating margins on an annualized basis stood at 37.3 basis points as compared to 36.6 basis points for H1 FY 26.

items.statement: Operating expenses rose 17.9% YoY and 6.2% QoQ to Rs 493 crore.
items.quote: Operating expenses amounted to 493 crore rupees, which was an increase by 17.9% year on year and 6.2% quarter on quarter.

items.quote: For H1 FY 27, on an annualized basis, the gross yield on our PMS and AIF business was 1.92%, and the net yield

items.statement: SIF quarterly average AUM nearly doubled to Rs 4,948 crore from Rs 2,678 crore.
items.quote: On SIF, we continue to see good traction, leading to quarterly average AUM of 4,948 crore rupees, in Q2 FY 27 versus 2,678 crore rupees in Q1 FY 27.

items.statement: Redemptions are currently somewhat elevated.
items.quote: So we see the net figures only. So right now, the redemptions are slightly higher. Yes, they are slightly higher.

items.statement: Industry quarterly average AUM grew 13.4% YoY and 5.1% QoQ.
items.quote: the industry quarterly average AUM has grown by 13.4% year on year, and 5.1% sequentially in Q2 FY 27, reaching 287.49 lakh crore rupees.

items.statement: Industry equity net flows were Rs 1.06 lakh crore, about 7% lower than the prior quarter.
items.quote: During this quarter, net flows for the equity categories was 1.06 lakh crore rupees, which marked approximately 7% reduction as compared to previous quarter.

items.statement: The board approved acquiring the PMS business of ICICI Securities.
items.quote: During the quarter, the board of the company had approved acquisition of PMS business from ICICI Securities Limited.

items.statement: Four SIF funds are launched and a fifth is due this quarter.
items.quote: We have launched four funds. We are going to launch fifth fund during the quarter. So we quite like the category.

items.statement: A new alternates fund combines listed and unlisted (private) investing capabilities.
items.quote: So we have launched a fund on the alternate side, which mixes our capability on the listed space and the capabilities that we have acquired on the non-listed space.

items.statement: Management sees opportunity in small caps and has fully opened its small cap fund.
items.quote: Small caps, we see the opportunity. So small cap fund, we have completely opened up.

items.statement: The international advisory book has seen outflows for about 18 months.
items.quote: since last one and a half years, since last one and a half years, we have had outflows in that.

items.statement: Management cannot say when international flows into India will return.
items.quote: But I don't know when the tide will turn internationally towards India.
